corrections.reason: The parenthetical alternative Amharic translation for Ge'ez ትርአይ ('that you may see') is the imperative እይ ('see!'), printed with 6th-order እ rather than 1st-order አ.
The printed glyph is 6th-order ስ (አስጥቶ, 'having caused to be thrown/given to wild beasts', matching Col 2 L33), not 1st-order ሰ.
